title: Mixing. Part 3
note: Silent. One bench at the mixing counter (sign MIXING / 10 MIN WAIT, paint shaker rattling behind with her POPPY-lidded can in it, a basket with a brush lying across it, a sample board at the right). Frame 1 fully composed, ONE strip (hook, 0-3.0, y=345): two large faces, his phone lit mid-swipe with a profile card + heart badge, she glances at it (1.7). Take 1 (3.0-8.2): chip SHOW HER / MY MATCHES., he scrolls her his matches (each stamped seen 3 wks ago), she winces and pats his shoulder. Fan-deck snaps shut (8.2-8.85), big 'rewind. take 2.' held 8.45-9.95. Take 2 (9.5-20.0): chip PHONE AWAY. / ASK HER., phone goes into the basket (10.8), chips with the pencil on the chain: he 'what's the / room for?', she 'my first / own place.', he 'mine too.'; shared laugh 16.95: shaker stops, bossa drops out. Insert 17.95-20.0: clerk hands slide two cans, both lids taped POPPY. Cliff: she dabs a test square on the board (20.45), holds out the brush, chip 'your turn.' (21.3). Fan-deck wipe 23.0, vote up by 24.1, end card 30.5. Text only between y=270 and y=1250. No NoSwipe mention.

hooks.a: the stranger in the paint aisle has ten minutes to kill with me.
hooks.b: a stranger caught me swiping. now we're stuck on one bench.

choices.question: she handed me the brush. what do I paint?
choices.why: Both are about him; neither mocks her. A is the corny reflex, B answers her first own place.

strips.text: I showed her my matches. she felt sorry for me.
phone in the basket. I ask on a chip.
